task.fixed_definition: Complement of RDKit Murcko scaffold, as used by this FLOWR version.
task.reference_index_space: Preprocessed reference, not necessarily original input SDF indices.
task.attachment_note: Reference cut-bond endpoints; these are not explicitly hard-constrained attachment labels in ROOT. Generated core atoms have no assumed one-to-one identity with the removed core.

network_prediction.strict_boundary_note: Descriptive only; disagreement with the reference is not used to label a failed sample.

sampler_state.strict_boundary_note: Descriptive only; disagreement with the reference is not used to label a failed sample.

unlocalized_endpoint_problems.reason: Atom-level geometry/environment tracing requires its own adapter; a PoseBusters failure alone does not establish a scaffold-fragment connection failure.

diagnosis.scaffold_change_note: Unchanged Murcko scaffold is reported separately, not as a connection error.

connection_report.timing_note: Early noisy bond choices are expected. Persistent terminal patterns describe observations, not causal failure onset. Call and sampler indices are different counters.
connection_report.scope: Boundary topology and fixed-atom diagnostics; no full geometry/scaffold-change assessment, hidden-layer analysis or causal intervention.

temporal_evidence.scope: Same final atom pair and element; not the earliest clash anywhere in the molecule. Intermediate noisy states are observations, not failed molecules.

raw_fixed_evidence.scope: Final argmax graph only; carbon-overvalence is one specific failure family, not a complete validity criterion.
